scope: one or more heads across all layers; common S9 fixed by externally supplied canonical QK bytes
exact_gauge: one GL(head_dimension) action shared across depth

common_head_permutation.canonical_key: full canonical QK routing bytes, sorted lexicographically
common_head_permutation.stored_reference: SHA256 of the external routing bytes
common_head_permutation.accounting: routing payload is not stored or charged again
common_head_permutation.tie_policy: equal QK keys are ordered by canonical V/O bytes; equal complete heads are indistinguishable
common_head_permutation.collision_policy: distinct routing keys with the same SHA256 digest fail closed
common_head_permutation.reason_v_o_cannot_order_heads_alone: a head permutation is a symmetry only when QK, V, and O move together

required_tests: byte equality under a shared GL gauge away from quantization boundaries
decoded action approaches canonical action within a quantization bound
independent per-layer gauges are not treated as equivalent
rank-deficient shared parent and malformed containers fail closed
literal bytes are not promoted without held-out, composite, extraction, removal, and OOD gates
common head permutation plus independent per-head shared GL actions produce identical bundle bytes
equal-routing heads are canonically ordered by V/O without rejecting a valid symmetry stratum
